widgets_values_named.text:
LOSSLESS CLIP CHAINING
----------------------
Chaining through video costs a decode + re-encode at every join.
That round trip darkens the picture ~2.4% each time and compounds.
Chaining the latent skips it entirely.

RUN 1 (first clip)
  Load Latent stays BYPASSED (it is, already).
  seed_video feeds the continuity as usual.
  -> Save Latent writes output/h3_latents/clip_00001

RUN 2 ONWARD
  1. Select Load Latent, press Ctrl+B to un-bypass it.
  2. Pick the newest file in its dropdown (newest is first).
  3. Write the new prompt. Run.
  -> Save Latent writes clip_00002, and so on.

NOTES
  seed_video can stay connected: once seed_latent is wired it is
  used only to supply real audio for the continuation window.

  Resolution is locked once you start. A latent cannot be resized,
  so every clip in a chain must use the same one.

  To redo a clip, just load the previous latent again. Nothing
  earlier needs re-rendering.

NAMING
  Set filename_prefix on Save Latent per scene, e.g. sato_scene
  -> sato_scene_00001, sato_scene_00002 ...
  You can also rename files afterwards in
  ComfyUI/output/h3_latents/ - keep the .safetensors ending
  and they stay in the dropdown.
